description.value:
Once per Long Rest when you see a Technique of no more than a single Ki Rank higher than you are that you could learn, you may memorize it.

Until you replace this move you may cast it without gaining your Proficiency Bonus. This Technique remains memorized until you replace it with a different Technique. If you learn the Technique that you have memorized it instantly gains 1 Rank of Mastery.
